verdict.rationale: Lithic clearly supports card issuing with card-level authorization rules (MCC, country, currency, risk score) and program/account/card-level spend limits, which together allow merchant-locking and velocity/amount controls [lithic-docs-3, lithic-docs-9, lithic-docs-13, lithic-docs-17]. However, the evidence never explicitly documents a 'single-use' card type or per-transaction exact-amount enforcement (one card = one purchase, auto-expire after use) — missing for 10: explicit single-use/one-time card mechanism, documentation of exact-amount (not just limit) authorization matching, and independent/hands-on confirmation that a leaked single-use number is rejected after first use.
